title: investigating opponents to climb the minihouse leaderboard is actually useful
summary: Minihouse (6x6 crazyhouse) leaderboard climb: starts at 1833 aiming for the leaderboard (lowest entry 2175, top all-time 2500), studying top players' openings; plays 1570-1876 opponents and sets a minimum rating 1804+.
rules: 6x6 board with normal chess pieces (reduced army).
Crazyhouse drops: captured pieces go to your pocket and can be dropped on any empty square as your move.
Pawns promote on the last rank (he promotes to a rook).
